archcore-ai-archcore-archcore-document.description: Record a decision, document existing code, or file a supplied research material, in free text; no first word is a mode. archcore-ai-archcore-archcore-init.description: First-time Archcore setup. Wires the host (MCP config, hooks, CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md managed block), measures the authored context the repo already holds, then composes a first-day seed — stack rule, run guide, data-model, integrations, config, entry points, public surface, a linked architecture overview, and specs for the top hotspot modules — shown in ONE preview and created on a single confirm. Modes, named as the first word: init import converts the repo's authored context — CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .cursor/rules and other agent instructions, ADR and RFC folders, contributor docs, internal…

archcore-ai-archcore-archcore-plan.description: Plan future work, investigate before building, research a topic, or compare the alternatives for a choice. Takes optional free text. The skill reads the request, open drafts, accepted canon, branch, and code, then creates only the documents a later reader needs — none for a small fix. Use for 'plan the X redesign', 'create a roadmap', 'plan a new feature', 'plan the onboarding journey', 'investigate X before we plan', 'compare the alternatives for Y', 'REST or a queue? two teams disagree', 'I need market research before we plan', 'we are regulated — trace the requirements'. With no arguments…

archcore-ai-archcore-archcore-review.description: The pre-merge review of a branch in a project that records its specs, decisions, and rules in .archcore/. Run this first for 'review my branch', 'review the changes before merge', or 'review before merge': it checks the changed code against the project's recorded canon and the changed documents against the code, and reports which side is wrong — spec-wrong or code-wrong; on the default branch it reviews the unpushed and uncommitted work.
